sqlquery.from:
( select lr.id, dp.name departmentName, coalesce(u.firstname,'')||' '||coalesce(u.lastname,'') employeeName,lr.startDate,lr.endDate,(lr.endDate-lr.startDate)::time datex ,coalesce(sts.name,'Pending') statusName ,reason.name reasonName,lr.description,type.name typeName , case when lr.toTakeFromAllowance then 'Yes' else 'No' end toTakeFromAllowanceData ,coalesce(approver.firstname,'')||' '||coalesce(approver.lastName,'') approverName , elr.takendays from "$".team dp left join "$".teamEmployee te on dp.id=te.teamId left join "$".employee e on te.id=e.employeeDepartmentId inner join "$".myuser u on e.id=u.id join "$".SickRequest lr on e.id=lr.employeeId left join "$".reference sts on lr.status=sts.id left join "$".reference reason on lr.reason=reason.id left join "$".reference type on lr.type=type.id
left join "$".myuser approver on lr.managerId=approver.id
left join (select att.employeeId as id, round(CAST (SUM(CASE WHEN att.holiday = false THEN att.leave/cast(att.timeslot as real) ELSE (CASE WHEN att.holidayfromannualleave = true THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) END) AS numeric) ,1)as takendays from "$".attendancerawdata att left join datejoin d on ( d.id = att.dateid) where att.dayoff is not true and leave !=0 and (date_part('year', d.from_date) = date_part('year', now())) group by att.employeeid) elr on e.id = elr.id
where dp.isdeleted is not true and u.deleted is not true
)t
